items.title: Dan Barrett interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Mr. Owen brought a couple of 78s by Tommy Dorsey and his orchestra... I'd never heard anything like that in my life

ctx.x: Marvelous. What led you to start playing the trombone other than any other instrument?

Well, actually I wanted to play trumpet, and in fifth grade I remember very clearly a gentleman came in and our teacher introduced him and she said his name was Ken Owen, and he taught in the band at our local junior high school. And many of us would be graduating from the elementary school and going on to his junior high school. And he told us he had a concert band over at the junior high and that he was starting a beginning band program at the elementary school for fifth and sixth graders. And he made a little…

whether we play music or not, that we’re continually surrounded by music and he said many of you have parents who will play the radio when you’re in the car and if you go shopping you hear music in the supermarket, and if you go to the dentist’s office they usually have music playing. And he said of course there’s background music for television shows. So he pointed out how big a part music plays in our everyday lives, and he said that he knew that some of us were probably thinking that we would like to try and…
